headline: 8 Juba League leaders arrested in Dhaka's Uttara Khan during secret meeting
summary: Police conducted a raid in the Taltala area based on secret information, while at least 30 others managed to escape.
details: Police have arrested eight leaders of the Juba League, an organization whose activities are currently banned, from the Uttara Khan area of the capital.
The Uttara Khan Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) stated that the arrests were made during a raid in the Taltala area, where the leaders were holding a secret meeting.
According to the OC, at least 30 other activists and leaders managed to flee the scene during the police operation.
Legal proceedings and the filing of cases against the arrested individuals are currently underway.
Police have confirmed that operations to arrest the remaining fugitives are ongoing.
caption:
8 Juba League leaders caught during a secret meeting in Dhaka. At least 30 others fled the scene.

Police have arrested eight leaders of the Juba League, an organization whose activities are currently banned, from the Uttara Khan area of the capital.

The Uttara Khan Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) stated that the arrests were made during a raid in the Taltala area, where the leaders were holding a secret meeting.

According to the OC, at least 30 other activists and leaders managed to flee the scene during the police operation.

Legal proceedings and the filing of cases against the arrested individuals are currently underway.

Police have confirmed that operations to arrest the remaining fugitives are ongoing.

headline_marked: BSF shoots [[Bangladeshi killed, 2 detained]] at Thakurgaon border
headline: BSF shoots Bangladeshi killed, 2 detained at Thakurgaon border
summary: A 35-year-old man from Pirganj was killed by the Border Security Force of India on Saturday morning.
details: A Bangladeshi man named Ashadul Huq (35) was killed by the Border Security Force (BSF) of India inside Indian territory near the Chanderhat border in Pirganj, Thakurgaon.
The incident occurred early Saturday morning (September 12) near the Radhikapur camp of the BSF in the Kaliyaganj police station area of North Dinajpur district, India.
Two other Bangladeshis, Mustakin (38) and Uda Chandra Roy (35), both from Indrail village in Pirganj, were detained by the BSF and handed over to the Kaliyaganj police station.
Lt. Col. Abdullah Al Moeen Hussain, commander of the 42 BGB battalion, confirmed the death of a Bangladeshi national, though he stated that full details are not yet available.
Pirganj Police Station OC Iqbal Hossain Pramanik noted that they had received news of the death through Indian media reports.
Information regarding the repatriation of the deceased's body has not yet been confirmed.
caption:
A Bangladeshi man was shot dead by the BSF in India, and two others were detained.

A Bangladeshi man named Ashadul Huq (35) was killed by the Border Security Force (BSF) of India inside Indian territory near the Chanderhat border in Pirganj, Thakurgaon.

The incident occurred early Saturday morning (September 12) near the Radhikapur camp of the BSF in the Kaliyaganj police station area of North Dinajpur district, India.

Two other Bangladeshis, Mustakin (38) and Uda Chandra Roy (35), both from Indrail village in Pirganj, were detained by the BSF and handed over to the Kaliyaganj police station.

Lt. Col. Abdullah Al Moeen Hussain, commander of the 42 BGB battalion, confirmed the death of a Bangladeshi national, though he stated that full details are not yet available.

Pirganj Police Station OC Iqbal Hossain Pramanik noted that they had received news of the death through Indian media reports.

Information regarding the repatriation of the deceased's body has not yet been confirmed.
